brand-icon.source: Package icon artwork (#20); scripts/icon.mjs geometry and docs/branding.md.
brand-icon.notes: The C2 "Line Break" mark was originally drawn for this repository as deterministic vector code: seven token bars and five recessed wells on a 56 px module, resolving only existing palette tokens. No third-party artwork, font, gradient, photograph, trace or generated image is embedded. It replaces an inherited photographic icon of unrecorded origin, which was removed rather than retained. Provenance is not permission: the repository license remains unresolved.

phase4-accessibility.source: Phase 4 (#7); docs/accessibility.md and generated accessibility evidence.
phase4-accessibility.notes: Darker warm planes and selective hue-preserving changes to existing families. Explicit composited sRGB text/indicator floors and selected-role CVD regression thresholds are engineering contracts, not complete WCAG conformance or a CVD user study. Flagship, Classic and Legacy are unchanged.

phase3-workbench.source: Phase 3 (#9); docs/theme-tokens.md modern workbench and semantic coverage.
phase3-workbench.notes: Authored warm three-plane surfaces, reusable interaction states and terminal colors extend the Phase 2 families without changing syntax swatches. Public VS Code IDs are coverage evidence, not color authority. Contrast remains a preview; no accessibility compliance or license grant is implied.

phase0.notes: Compatibility authority for the 2.1.1 appearance, NOT historical Coda authority. Includes Phase 0 selection transparency and invalid-token fixes from 80972e6. Scope coverage includes One Dark Pro-derived assignments; retaining them is not endorsing their semantic palette.

coda1.source: Joseph Bergantine original Coda 1 .seestyle package, transcribed in docs/theme-token-comparison.md; analysis Git blob 94a1e18eaaa76d50a96a4260d366ca30b02e925a
coda1.notes: Native, language-specific Coda data. Evidence on each reference token names the mode/token, not a universal semantic assignment. The comparison predates Phase 0; do not use its current-VS-Code table as the compatibility baseline.

coda2-atom.source: https://github.com/mikelentini/Specials-Board; Coda 2 Atom reconstruction table in analysis Git blob 94a1e18eaaa76d50a96a4260d366ca30b02e925a
coda2-atom.notes: Community reconstruction, not a Panic Coda 2 export. Kept separate from authoritative Coda 1 and repository history.

repository-textmate.notes: Original checked-in translation retained unchanged as evidence. Not the post-Phase-0 VS Code appearance and not authoritative Coda-native data.

phase2-interpretation.source: Phase 2 (#8); docs/theme-tokens.md palette and ordered mapping decisions.
phase2-interpretation.notes: Coda 1 swatches are authoritative only for their cited native language rows. Universal roles, modern grammar classification, readable comments, red underlined invalid text, Markdown, and flagship color adjustments are explicit engineering judgments. No One Dark Pro or Coda 2 reconstruction is semantic authority. License remains deferred.

phase1-role-extraction.source: Phase 1 (#5), extracted from the post-Phase-0 theme's roles and ordered scope rules.
phase1-role-extraction.notes: Role naming and grouping are engineering judgments. Aliases preserve existing colors, even when different semantic roles happen to share a color. No Phase 2 palette restoration is implied. License remains deferred: provenance is not permission or a license grant.
